parameters.query: INSERT INTO activity_log (org_id, program_id, actor_id, event_type, event_data) SELECT i.org_id, NULL, i.invited_by, 'invite_sent', jsonb_build_object('email', '{{ $json.email }}', 'role', '{{ $json.role }}', 'invite_url', '{{ $json.invite_url }}', 'org_name', '{{ $json.org_name }}') FROM invites i WHERE i.token_hash = encode(digest('{{ $json.invite_token }}', 'sha256'), 'hex')

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, email: $('Build Invite URL').first().json.email, invite_url: $('Build Invite URL').first().json.invite_url }) }}
